### Historical audit: H0173

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane2/codex_parallel_12_lane2_I_r3/infer_logs/ink-grid-box-layout/turn_1/trajs.json`. All event citations below refer to this file; offsets are character ranges in the supplied observations.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The task name and student’s statement indicate an intended grid-layout implementation; the exact requirements are not visible. The student also described a requested branch and commit based on `main`, but the underlying request is not shown (event 1, [0,606); event 4, [0,863)). |
| Autonomous exploration | The student ran one command inspecting the working directory, Git status, branches, latest commit and directory listing (event 2, [0,699)). It returned detached HEAD at `0cea591`, branch `master`, no displayed `main`, and no short-status entries (event 3, [0,980)). No reproduction or source inspection is visible. |
| Changes and validation | No edit, branch creation, commit or test execution appears in the trajectory. Inventory metadata reports a zero-byte patch and formal evaluation of 0/25 fail-to-pass and 49/49 pass-to-pass tests: **empty patch, formally not solved**, not evidence of an algorithmic failure. The evaluation results are metadata, not visible test logs. |
| Teacher input | The inventory lists available hint and review files, but availability does not establish receipt; after-round review cannot be input to this round. The supplied trajectory shows no delivered teacher text or adoption. Metadata reports zero teacher checks and zero wait time (top-level metadata, [0,4892)). The captured system prompt and online state contents are not supplied, so actual input cannot be fully determined. |
| Stop | The student asked for a valid `main` ref or confirmation to use `master` and ended the turn (event 4, [0,863); top-level metadata, [0,4892)). This is a branch-base blocker in the student’s account, not a tool interruption: the command reports `interrupted: false` (event 3, [0,980)). |

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Checking repository state before changing it is transferable; the missing `main` ref and requested base are specific to this checkout. Whether implementation could safely have proceeded from another base, what the full specification required, and whether any teacher guidance was actually present in the unseen prompt remain unresolved. This is a software-layout trace, not a scene reconstruction; scene-object, material, pose and render checks are not applicable.
